title: Specialist HR Country Management
description:
**Job Title : Specialist, HR Country Management**

**Location : Bangalore**

**Type : Regular, Full time**

**Onsite working / Office worker**  

  



**Job Summary**


Specialist, HR Country Management is responsible for supporting employees, BU managers across a broad range of country HR matters for Bangalore location. In addition, this role is also required to partner with primary HRCMs / other stakeholders in supporting important HR projects / deliverables across India and other countries, as required. The role also provides business facilitation and transformation support to ensure effective execution of HR priorities.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* Provide organizational support for Bangalore in the areas of:
	+ Labour compliance
	+ Employee relations
	+ Compensation and benefits
	+ Organizational development
	+ Policies and procedures
	+ Case management
	+ Mergers \& Acquisitions
	+ Workforce planning initiatives
* Support in drafting country\-specific HR policies, procedures, and manuals.
* Facilitate employee engagement programs and initiatives in the location
* Support and manage employee grievances.
* Handle workforce planning activities in coordination with business and HR stakeholders.
* Manage employee casework, including disciplinary procedures and related documentation.
* Hands on experience on handling coaching and performance improvement plans
* Collaborate with extended HR teams to effectively implement HRCM activities.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with employees, managers, and business unit leaders to support effective implementation of HR policies.
* Support HRCMs in HR\-related mergers and acquisitions activities.
* Provide business facilitation and transformation support as required.

 **Education and Qualifications \& Other Mandatory Requirements**

* Higher education required, preferably **MBA in HR** or **MSW** or **equivalent**
* **Office worker – Expected to work 5 days from the office.**

 **Relevant Work Experience**

* **8 years of relevant HR experience**, preferably in the **IT/ITES sector.**
* At least 5 years of close experience in handling case management, workforce planning and employee grievance handling.

 **Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Experience in labour compliance will be an added advantage.
* Knowledge in AI is highly recommended
* Relevant work experience in Factories / Manufacturing set up in an added advantage
* Open minded individuals, who can quickly align with the organization culture, role and the team
* Self\-motivated and able to work with minimal supervision.
* Quick adaptability for MNC environment and navigate the path independently
* Strong conflict management skills and ability to deal effectively with difficult situations and stakeholders.
* Willingness to take on additional responsibilities as required.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Good teamwork and relationship\-building abilities.
* Strong people management and problem\-solving skills.
* Sound knowledge of handling disciplinary cases, terminations, and employee grievances.
* Knowledge in HR mergers and acquisitions.

 **Weekly Hours:**


40**Time Type:**


Regular**Location:**


Bangalore, India
